description: Materialized current POS loyalty points balance per client — a projection over posRewardTransactions, kept in sync transactionally by the same stored procedures that insert ledger rows (sp_posRewardTransactions_earnFromTicket, sp_posRewardTransactions_adjust, sp_posRewardRedemptions_redeem). Never written directly by the frontend. Fully separate from the existing loan-behavior rewardBalances table — no shared key, no conversion.

fields.name: lifetimeEarned
fields.description: Running total of all EARN points ever posted for this client.

fields.name: lifetimeRedeemed
fields.description: Running total of all REDEEM points ever posted for this client.

fields.name: lastActivity
fields.description: Timestamp of the most recent ledger entry affecting this balance.

relationships.notes: Multi-tenant isolation via companyId — injected automatically by stored procedures.
One balance row per client per company; UNIQUE(companyId, clientId).

components.name: PosRewardDashboardSummaryStep
components.description: Admin dashboard: KPI cards (points issued, points redeemed, redemptions count), a points-activity time series, and a top-customers leaderboard sourced from this table + posRewardTransactions.

components.name: PosRewardCartBalanceStep
components.description: Small balance readout shown in the POS cart once a client is selected at checkout, plus a 'points to next reward' progress bar against the cheapest active posRewardCatalogItems row.

endpoints.description: Takes { companyId, startDate?, endDate? }. Aggregates across posRewardTransactions (points issued/redeemed in the period, activity time series) and posRewardRedemptions (redemptions count), plus this table (top customers by balance/lifetimeEarned). Returns { pointsIssued, pointsRedeemed, redemptionsCount, topCustomers: [{clientId, balance, lifetimeEarned}], activity: [{date, earned, redeemed}] }. Read-only, cross-table — does not write anything.

hints: This table is written ONLY inside the same transaction as a posRewardTransactions insert — the standard CRUD SP's action 1/2 (insert/update) should be restricted to internal callers (the earn/adjust/redeem SPs), not exposed as a general-purpose write the frontend can call directly.
sp_posRewardBalances_dashboardSummary is read-only and joins posRewardTransactions + posRewardRedemptions for the period aggregates described in the endpoint above.
